environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance (m5.large) in us-east-1 VPC subnet-0a1b2c3d, running behind an internal ALB (scheme=internal) with target group health checks. Security group sg-0xf4a8b allows inbound TCP/8080 from 10.0.0.0/8. The application runs with gunicorn using 4 worker threads (--threads 4). Multiple internal microservices can reach this endpoint concurrently. No request deduplication or rate limiting is configured on the ALB or application layer.
